info.description: Sign-in and sessions are handled by Better Auth under /api/auth/*. Signed-in requests send the session cookie it sets.

get.description: Your personal lists and the lists of every household you are in, with their items. A list with a `householdId` is shared with that household; one without is only yours.

post.description: Send `householdId` to share the list with a household you are in; leave it out for a personal list. You may choose the `id` yourself (a UUID): sending the same id again returns the existing list, which makes a retry after a lost connection safe.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

409.description: That id is already used by another list

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

delete.description: The person who made the list can delete it. For a household list, the household's owners can too.

403.description: Only the person who made the list or a household owner can delete it

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add an item to a list
post.description: Adds one line as written. `quantity` stays null when you don't give an amount. You may choose the item's `id`; sending the same id again changes nothing.

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

409.description: That id is already used by another item

200.description: The list without the ticked-off items

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

patch.summary: Change or tick off an item
patch.description: Only the fields you send change. Send `checked` to tick an item on or off.

The list or the item doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add a recipe's ingredients to a list
post.description: Scales the amounts to `servings` (the recipe's own servings by default) and merges identical ingredients: the same name with the same unit adds up (200 g + 100 g flour is 300 g). Different units stay on separate lines, and an ingredient without an amount is added without one. You need to be able to see the recipe.

200.description: The list with the ingredients added

404.description: The list or the recipe doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add a recipe from a video or website link
post.description: Queues a job that reads the link (Instagram Reel, TikTok, YouTube Short or a recipe website) and saves the result as a recipe. Websites with recipe data need no AI key.

202.description: The job was queued. Poll `GET /extractions/{jobId}` for the result.

400.description: Unsupported or invalid link, or an address on a private network

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

503.description: No AI key is set on this server

202.description: The job was queued. Poll `GET /extractions/{jobId}` for the result.

get.summary: Check a job and get its result
get.description: `status` is `queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or `failed`. When it succeeded, `recipe` is the saved recipe. When it failed, `error` says why.

404.description: The job doesn't exist, or it is not yours
